name: Genoa
intro: Explore 31 publicly recorded Comune di Genova ERP locations managed through ARTE. Markers join the current ERP register to the Comune’s civic-address map.
mapLabel: Interactive map of documented ERP housing locations in Genoa
footnote: 31 verified ERP address locations. These are the entries in the June 2026 Comune di Genova register that could be matched to a current official civic point. This is not a complete census of social housing.
